notes.title: The Blue Cut Hook [DEMO] is Live Now !
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS, TRAVELERS!ːsteamhappyː[/h1]

First off, a huge thank you to all our amazing [b]patrons[/b] for your patience while waiting to jump into the full demo. We hit a few bumps along the road (turns out Steam has a lot of requirements), but we’ve sorted it all out and we’re thrilled to announce that the page is officially live!

[h3]"Grab your gear and get ready for adventure your journey starts now!"[/h3] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661420/The_Blue_Cut_Hook_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661420/The_Blue_Cut_Hook_Demo/
[/url]
And once you’ve had a chance to explore, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback is like treasure to us,
it helps make the game even better!
